title: MathShow Identity UI Primitives And Cards
acceptance: IdentityTheme, IdentityCopy and AssetIds are added from the v3 package with numbers unchanged; an unset asset id warns once and renders nothing, never errors.

RankBadge, ModeIcon, FormatIcon, TrackChip, TagChip, StatusChip, StatusSlot, DeltaPill, RankChangePill and ProgressBar are pure props-to-Instances builders; their layout numbers and the status-priority, tag and progress rules are covered by headless specs.

GameplayCard, RevealCard, IntroCard and ResultsRow take all six variants (default, YOU, bot, first-correct, disconnected, spectating) and fall back to the portrait icon after a 3 s headshot timeout without blocking the card.
A Studio board harness renders the README stress fixtures at 844x390 and the text-fit gate passes every row with a 6 px margin; differences from the S-screenshots over 2 px are reported.
Nothing is wired into the HUD or menu, no remote, payload or DataStore field changes, nothing is uploaded, and check.sh passes with the MathShow spec count above 258.
